# Claude Code 2.1.312 headless and response-only identity

`dist-inventory.json` freezes the npm wrapper, Darwin arm64 package, and Linux x64 package from the previous ceiling `2.1.310` through official stable `2.1.312`. The re-downloaded `2.1.310` tarball and `claude` digests match Research 445. Every tarball was checked against current npm SHA-512 integrity and hashed per file. No downloaded executable was run.

`marker-ledger.json` records the exact marker and stream-json help-line arrays. `selected-control-flow.json` binds measured selected JS on `2.1.310`, `2.1.311`, and `2.1.312` to those executable hashes. Identifier remangling changes the snippets. The decision structure does not. `response-only-isolation.json` freezes `--safe-mode`, the builtin-only plugin filter, init fields, the permissionMode default mapper, and `@builtin` plugin ids on the same hops. `cc-plugin-claude-platform` is absent at `2.1.310` and registered from `2.1.311`; print mode fails its interactive availability gate even if the dynamic flag is enabled. The fixture freezes the print detector, setter, getter, availability filter and safe-mode MCP gate. Easel also gains a `remote_cowork` registration on that hop. Neither is a selected mapped change.

`headless-identity.json` and `headless-protocol.json` are the headless claim. `response-only-identity.json` and `response-only-protocol.json` are the response-only claim. At observation, npm `latest` and GitHub latest non-prerelease agree on `2.1.312`. npm `stable` remains the delayed channel at `2.1.308`. npm `next` is also `2.1.312`. `2.1.313` is absent. Research 459 records the qualification. Claude Agent ACP and the Claude Agent SDK stay separate claims.
